amendments.reason: A topology basis typically comprises open sets, but the source only requires a basis of quasi-compact neighborhoods, possibly not open. Reclassify the imprecise link as unassigned.
amendments.review_rationale: Reviewed complete formulation and corrected overly broad open-topology-basis link to an unassigned neighborhood-basis construction while retaining quasi-compactness and the explicit quantifiers.

references.context: Topology: a local neighborhood basis consisting of quasi-compact neighborhoods, not necessarily open subsets

references.phrase: neighborhood of a point in a topological space
references.context: Topology: subset containing an open set around the point, not necessarily open itself

references.phrase: for every neighborhood U of x
references.disposition: The quasi-compact neighborhood K can depend on both x and U, and no ambient Hausdorff condition is asserted.
